objective: Make workflow lifecycle, editing, history and internal electronic signatures safe, traceable and usable without changing active instance execution semantics.
users: Workflow administrators archive, restore, edit and inspect definitions.
Approvers confirm an internal signature with their authenticated identity when a published node requires it.
Auditors inspect definition events, immutable versions and signature evidence.
Business modules consume the platform workflow API without accessing Flowable tables.

requirements.statement: Draft definitions may be deleted while published definitions must be archived and may be restored by an administrator with a reason.
acceptance: archive blocks new starts without affecting running instances or history
restore reuses the prior published version and does not create a new version
requirements.source: User approved archive and restore behavior on 2026-08-17.

requirements.statement: Adding a node from a zero-edge or single-edge node must append or atomically insert and reconnect the graph.
acceptance: single-edge insertion produces parent-to-new and new-to-original-target edges
the resulting graph saves and publishes
multiple outgoing branches are not guessed
requirements.source: User requested automatic node and edge creation.
counterexample: user must manually delete the existing edge

requirements.statement: The workflow editor must fit the viewport with persistent title and footer actions and an independently scrollable content region.
acceptance: save remains reachable on desktop and 375x812, 390x844 and 430x932 viewports
requirements.source: User reported the save button was below the visible workflow dialog.
counterexample: browser zoom is required to save
fixed canvas height pushes the footer off screen

requirements.statement: Definition detail must expose immutable version history and definition-scoped update events.
acceptance: all versions are listed and a selected version graph opens read-only
create, update, publish, unpublish, archive and restore events show operator, time, version and reason
requirements.source: User reported missing history versions and update records.

requirements.statement: Approval nodes must expose the existing signature requirement as explicit Yes/No and preserve backend enforcement and authenticated evidence for approve, reject and return actions.
acceptance: signature Yes/No is visible in approval node configuration and defaults to No
required actions without confirmation remain rejected before engine progression
successful signed decisions continue to persist existing wf_signature evidence without regression
requirements.source: User confirmed login-identity confirmation signing and node-level workflow configuration.
counterexample: signature persists while approval rolls back

requirements.statement: A new append-only migration and corrected mock source must keep schema-version metadata consistent with schemaVersion 2 JSON without modifying V34.
acceptance: mock synchronization does not recreate mismatches
requirements.source: Repository and local database inspection on 2026-08-17.
counterexample: Flyway reports success but mock startup restores invalid metadata

invariants: running instances remain bound to their original definition version and deployment
tenant and entity authorization is enforced by the backend
business and frontend code never writes Flowable ACT tables
rokey-only uncommitted or unmerged business code is not included
constraints: existing definitionJson field and schemaVersion 2 remain compatible
platform internal signature only; no external CA
non_goals: automatic branch choice for multi-edge gateways

selected_approach.name: incremental cross-layer workflow closure
selected_approach.reason: It reuses Flowable, wf_version and wf_audit_event while closing lifecycle, history, editor and signature behavior with bounded changes.

alternatives.name: frontend-only fixes
alternatives.rejected_because: cannot enforce lifecycle or signatures and cannot supply reliable history

alternatives.name: workflow model redesign
alternatives.rejected_because: unnecessary blast radius and regression risk for the requested repairs

inside: workflow frontend API, designer, inspector and view
workflow migrations and local mock workflow metadata

components.name: WorkflowDesigner
components.responsibility: append or insert nodes while preserving a valid graph

components.name: WorkflowNodeInspector
components.responsibility: present the existing approval-node signature requirement as explicit Yes/No

components.name: WorkflowView
components.responsibility: definition lifecycle, history UI, responsive editor and generic signing interaction

components.name: WorkflowController
components.responsibility: authenticated lifecycle, history and action HTTP adaptation

components.name: WorkflowService and FlowableWorkflowService
components.responsibility: state transitions, history queries and regression-safe use of existing transactional signature enforcement

components.name: WorkflowAuditService
components.responsibility: definition and task audit event persistence

components.name: Flyway and mock synchronization
components.responsibility: schema-version metadata consistency while preserving V35 signature schema

interfaces.name: definition archive and restore
interfaces.contract: state-checked transition with mandatory reason and audit

interfaces.name: definition versions and events
interfaces.contract: tenant-scoped immutable version data and definition-only events

interfaces.name: task decision
interfaces.contract: signatureConfirmed is required only when the bound published node requires signing for approve, reject or return

data_flows.input: single outgoing graph edge plus add-node command
transitions: replace original edge with two edges
write action, audit and signature in one transaction
data_flows.output: approved decision with immutable evidence or no state change

error_handling.condition: lifecycle action does not match current status
error_handling.behavior: return an explicit conflict error without mutation
error_handling.recovery: refresh definition and select a valid action

error_handling.condition: multi-edge node is used for add-from-here
error_handling.behavior: leave the graph unchanged and request a specific edge
error_handling.recovery: select or right-click the intended edge

error_handling.behavior: reject before Flowable progression and write no partial evidence
error_handling.recovery: confirm signing as the current authenticated user and resubmit

error_handling.behavior: roll back task action and engine-related business synchronization
error_handling.recovery: retry after storage availability is restored

error_handling.behavior: show a scoped error without hiding the current definition

security: RBAC for delete, archive and restore
compatibility: existing definitionJson and active instances remain valid
archived status does not remove deployments
operations: schema mismatch count as a verification sensor
application rollback leaves corrected metadata and evidence intact

verification_strategy.signal: lifecycle and history service tests plus API/browser flows pass
verification_strategy.method: JDK 17 focused tests and authenticated browser verification

verification_strategy.signal: inserted graph preserves successor and passes backend model validation
verification_strategy.method: component-level graph checks and save/publish browser flow

verification_strategy.signal: footer actions remain visible/reachable without page overflow
verification_strategy.method: desktop and 375x812, 390x844, 430x932 screenshots and DOM overflow checks

verification_strategy.signal: unsigned required decisions fail and signed decisions create one immutable evidence row
verification_strategy.method: service/API tests and database aggregate verification

verification_strategy.signal: V34 is unchanged and mismatch counts are zero after migration and mock sync
verification_strategy.method: Flyway validation and read-only MySQL aggregate queries

assumptions.text: wf_definition.status can store ARCHIVED without a column type change
assumptions.basis: the current schema uses a string status and queries explicitly gate PUBLISHED starts
assumptions.falsifier: schema inspection reveals an enum/check constraint

assumptions.text: the existing V35 authenticated confirmation remains sufficient for internal signing
assumptions.basis: user explicitly selected current-login confirmation and no external CA
assumptions.falsifier: a legal or compliance requirement mandates certificate-backed signatures

assumptions.text: definition events do not require a visual field-by-field graph diff
assumptions.basis: the request asks for historical versions and update records, both supplied by snapshots and events

decisions.decision: Published definitions are archived rather than deleted and administrators may restore them
decisions.source: User approved archive and restore on 2026-08-17.

decisions.decision: Electronic signature is configured on approval nodes and enforced for approve, reject and return
decisions.source: User confirmed the signature design section on 2026-08-17.

decisions.decision: Do not modify V34; append repair migrations
decisions.reason: Flyway migrations are immutable after execution
decisions.source: Repository governance and user-confirmed data design.

risks.risk: an archived definition remains startable through an overlooked path
risks.mitigation: centralize published-definition lookup and test all start APIs

risks.impact: workflow cannot publish or reaches the wrong successor
risks.mitigation: atomic array construction, graph validation and browser save/publish test

risks.risk: signature requirement is read from the current rather than bound version
risks.mitigation: load definition_json by task instance definition_id and version_no

risks.risk: migration numbers collide with already executed local history
risks.impact: Flyway validation or future branch integration fails
risks.mitigation: use V42 after observed local V40/V41 history and require Owner review of migration ordering

approval.evidence: User confirmed every design section and explicitly requested implementation on 2026-08-17.
